description: This file defines a utility function 'formatStatusLabel' that converts raw deployment status codes into human-readable labels. It handles string normalization, replacement of underscores/hyphens with spaces, collapsing multiple spaces, and converting text to Title Case while preserving apostrophes.

methods.name: formatStatusLabel(value)
methods.description: Converts a raw status code string into a human-readable label with proper formatting, handling null/undefined/empty inputs, and maintaining the casing conventions.
